description: This file defines an abstract class for routing dispatch based on regex matching in the FastRoute library. It includes route lookup logic for static, variable, fallback, and method-allowed cases, but does not implement specific route dispatching logic.

classes.name: RegexBasedAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class that provides the core dispatch logic for routing in the FastRoute library, handling static, variable, fallback, and allowed method responses.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Main method to dispatch an HTTP request based on method and URI, checking static routes, variable routes, fallback routes, and allowed methods.

methods.name: dispatchVariableRoute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for dispatching variable routes based on route data and URI.
